tokens.name: deco-navy
tokens.usage: Brand. The logo lettering color (GOLF & GAMES). Headlines on cream, and the Night ground. Sampled from the key art.

tokens.name: lagoon-teal
tokens.usage: Brand. The logo ampersand and the mahjong tile. Secondary headline color on cream (5.8:1). White text on it passes (6.6:1).

tokens.name: ocean-teal
tokens.usage: Brand. The art deco waves at the bottom of the key art. Decorative fills only; never a text color on cream.

tokens.name: classic-red
tokens.usage: Brand. The word CLASSIC and the 'vs'. Fill for the main call-to-action button with white text (4.6:1). For red TEXT on cream use accent, which is darker.

tokens.name: deco-gold
tokens.usage: Brand. The double-line gold frame and sunburst in the key art. Rules, frames and ornaments on cream; text color only on navy (9.2:1).

tokens.name: shore-cream
tokens.usage: Brand. The cream panel behind the logo. Default page and email background.

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Brand. Top of the sunset sky. Illustration and photo-overlay fills only.

tokens.name: sunset-pink
tokens.usage: Brand. Middle of the sunset sky. Illustration and soft background fills only; never text.

tokens.name: sun-gold
tokens.usage: Brand. The setting sun. Highlight fills (a date chip, a badge) with deco-navy text (13:1).

tokens.name: team-marjcc
tokens.usage: Team color for Team MARJCC, taken from the MARJCC logo. Use for scoreboards, team labels and team jerseys or caps.

tokens.name: team-mbjcc
tokens.usage: Team color for Team Miami Beach JCC, taken from the MBJCC logo. Use for scoreboards, team labels and team jerseys or caps. White text on it passes at 18px bold and up only (4.4:1).

tokens.name: deco-beige
tokens.usage: Brand. The one beige ground of every piece.

tokens.name: deco-beige-deep
tokens.usage: Brand. The outer margin around an email or page, one step darker than deco-beige.

tokens.name: ray-tan
tokens.usage: Brand. Soft sunburst rays inside the arch and the card arches, on deco-beige.

tokens.name: band-gold
tokens.usage: Brand. The gold block of the top color band.

tokens.name: line-gold
tokens.usage: Brand. Gold double lines, frames and borders.

tokens.name: date-gold
tokens.usage: Brand. The date on the navy stepped plaque (9:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and email background: the one beige used everywhere (Night: navy for the half-sun and dark pieces).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Same beige as surface on Day: the brand never changes beige tones between sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface and surface-raised (13:1 Day, 11.7:1 Night).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, legal lines on surface and surface-raised (7:1 Day, 7.5:1 Night).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Red text: the 'vs', short emphasis words, links, on surface (5.1:1 Day, 5.2:1 Night).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Teal text: the ampersand, second line of a headline, on surface (5.8:1 Day, 7.3:1 Night).

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold text: eyebrows like SAVE THE DATE, GOLF, MAHJONG, on beige (5:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Gold double lines: the continuous side frame, arch, plaques, card arches, fan divider.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Register, Learn more).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action (13.6:1 Day, 9.2:1 Night).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on classic-red fills (4.6:1). Use 15px bold or larger.

tokens.name: partner-ground
tokens.usage: The partner logo strip. Stays white in every theme so the three full-color partner logos always sit on a clean light ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid, 2px offset (5.8:1 on cream, 9.2:1 on navy).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and social headline. Three to five words. Title Case.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headings on the landing page, email headline.

styles.name: matchup
styles.sample: TEAM MARJCC vs. TEAM MIAMI BEACH JCC
styles.usage: The matchup line. ALL CAPS, with 'vs.' in accent.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card and block headings. ALL CAPS.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label over a headline, in gold-text. ALL CAPS, wide tracking like CLASSIC in the logo.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Golf: May the best team win! Mahjong: Everyone plays together!
styles.usage: Running text on web. In email, the same size in the email family.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, footers, legal lines, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between the two lines of the gold double rule.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, button vertical padding x1.1, gap inside the facts block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between logos in the partner strip.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on phone, email section padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Buttons, cards, the strip: square like the deco frame.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Form fields only.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Top corners of an arch panel (the rounded top of the logo badge). Apply to top-left and top-right only.
